Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: Offline neural TTS support for EPUB, PDF, and TXT with synchronized reading highlighter.

English.Keywords: text to speech, tts, epub reader, audiobook player, offline tts, pdf reader, windows read aloud
English.Char_Desc_80: Read TXT and EPUB aloud offline. Pro adds PDF, Word import, and more voices.
English.Char_Desc_250: Vox Reader reads TXT and DRM-free EPUB aloud offline on Windows. Free includes 3 English voices and 3 listening hours per week. Pro adds unlimited listening, 11 voices, text-based PDF/DOCX import, and custom pronunciations.
English.Char_Desc_450: Vox Reader reads your documents aloud using English voices generated on your PC’s CPU. Free supports TXT, DRM-free EPUB and pasted text, with 3 listening hours each week. Pro adds unlimited listening, all 11 voices, text-based PDF/DOCX import and custom pronunciations. Search, bookmarks and local backup remain available. Higher speeds can pause while speech is generated. Buying or refreshing Pro requires internet access.
English.Char_Desc_2000: Vox Reader is an offline English text-to-speech reader for Windows 10 version 2004 or later and Windows 11 (x64). Documents stay on your PC. Free includes TXT, DRM-free EPUB and pasted text, 3 English voices, and 3 listening hours each week, resetting Monday. Pro adds unlimited listening, all 11 English voices, text-based PDF/Word import and custom pronunciations. Search, bookmarks, highlighting, sleep timer and local backup support your library. Voice loading can take several seconds; CPU performance affects playback, and higher speeds may pause while more speech is generated. Scanned PDFs require a text layer. No document uploads, app account, advertising or analytics. Microsoft Store handles the one-time Pro purchase; buying or refreshing Pro requires internet access.
